card.name: Scattered words inside drug-label phrases
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires weakly on varied words in drug-label sentences, such as a space before a percent, 'Injection' after a product name, or 'forced' before diuresis.

modes.label: Product name endings
modes.description: The word Injection closing a long product name in a drug label.
